title: decree status --format json
description: What `decree status --format json` prints on stdout. With no id: the counts by status, the runs in each group with the facts the text shows, and the queued messages. With an id: that run's derived status and its events, each a line of events.jsonl parsed. An unknown id is an error: nothing on stdout, `error: no run <id> in .decree/runs/` on stderr, exit code 1, as text does. With `--cron`: each cron file and when it fires next, `@reboot` files marked as firing at daemon start. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

overview.description: `decree status`: the files in .decree/attention/, every run by status, then the queued messages.

attention.description: Each `.md` file directly in .decree/attention/ (docs/reference/cli.md, Attention), those that hold the queue first, each group by name: its frontmatter (attention.schema.json) plus `path`. A file decree cannot read as one has `path`, `holds: true` and `error`, why it holds.

path.description: The file, from the project root: `.decree/attention/<name>.md`.

holds.description: Whether the file holds the queue.

error.description: Why a file decree cannot read holds: `no frontmatter`, `invalid frontmatter: <error>` or `cannot be read: <error>`.

kind.description: As in attention.schema.json: the file is about a run, or `decree stop` wrote it.

status.description: Why the run needs a person.

state.description: The state the run is in.

since.description: When the run's status changed, or when `decree stop` wrote the file, RFC 3339 UTC.

nested.description: Decree projects below this one (at most 4 folders down, not in hidden folders, node_modules, target, vendor or dist) that have active runs, in path order. Absent when none has.

path.description: The project's folder, relative to this project's root.

counts.description: How many runs there are, in all and per status.

finished.description: Runs that are finished, in any final state.

runs.description: The runs of each status (docs/reference/messages.md, Run status), each list in id order.

finished.description: Finished runs by the final state they ended in, such as `done` and `failed`.

inbox.description: Filenames in inbox/, in filename order.

executing.description: Each machine with a run executing now (an `active` run, in any process): how many, and its `concurrency`, the most that may execute at once. A run waiting for a reply, a timer or a child is not executing. Reference: docs/reference/machines.md, Concurrency.

running.description: How many of the machine's runs execute now.

limit.description: The machine's `concurrency`, which every machine of its group shares: the most that may execute at once, of the machine or, with `group`, of the group.

group.description: The machine's `concurrency_group`: its runs share that group's slots.

group_running.description: With `group`: how many runs of every machine in the group execute now, against `limit`.

state.description: The state the run is in, or ended in; `-` before its first transition.

running.description: For an `active` run, the script running now.

wait_id.description: For a run waiting in a `reply` state, the wait id a reply names.

options.description: For a run waiting in a `reply` state, the events it accepts.

child.description: For a run waiting for a child run (a `machine` invoke or a router), the child's run id.

running.description: The script an active run is running now, from .running (docs/reference/scripts.md, Execution).

started_at.description: When it started: RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.

log.description: Its log file, relative to the project root.

status.description: The run's status, derived from its events (docs/reference/messages.md, Run status).

state.description: The state the run is in, or ended in; null before its first transition.

events.description: Every line of the run's events.jsonl, parsed, in order.

cron.description: `decree status --cron`: the files in .decree/cron/ and its folders (`cron/<plugin>/`) that parse.
One entry per cron file, sorted by file name.

file.description: The file's path in .decree/cron/: `<file>.md`, or `<plugin>/<file>.md` for a cron file a plugin installed.

cron.description: Its `cron:` value as written: a cron expression or `@reboot`.

machine.description: Its `machine:`, or null when it names none.

next.description: When it fires next, RFC 3339 UTC; null for `@reboot`, and for a schedule with no time left.

at_daemon_start.description: True for `@reboot`: it fires once each time `decree daemon` starts, and at no other time (docs/reference/messages.md, Cron files).
